sections.heading: Before or After Your Delivery Order

blocks.html: Known as the First Borough of Bergen County, Rutherford Boro, NJ, pairs a peaceful, tree-lined residential character with a genuinely vibrant downtown and easy access to the Meadowlands entertainment corridor just minutes away. Wherever your day takes you, there's no shortage of great places to explore. And for weed delivery Rutherford locals count on when they’re back at home, Lady L is ready when you are.

blocks.title: Memorial Park
blocks.html: Rutherford's largest recreational destination, Memorial Park stretches along the Hackensack River and delivers an impressive range of amenities in one well-maintained space. Baseball and softball fields, soccer fields, tennis courts, a running track, walking paths, picnic areas with grills, and a Civil War Memorial monument make it a genuine anchor of community life.

blocks.title: Lincoln Park
blocks.html: Situated across from Borough Hall on Park Ave, Lincoln Park is the heart of Rutherford's community gathering tradition. The Hutzel Memorial Bandshell anchors a beloved free Summer Concert Series that draws residents together on warm evenings, while the park itself serves as a year-round backdrop for festivals, multicultural celebrations, and neighborhood events.

blocks.title: Williams Center for the Arts
blocks.html: An artist-run arts center right in Rutherford's downtown, the Williams Center bills itself as the heart of town, and the programming backs that up. From live concerts and underground cinema to community gatherings and special events, it serves as a genuine cultural hub for residents and visitors drawn to something off the beaten path.

blocks.title: Meadowlands Museum
blocks.html: Located on Crane Avenue, the Meadowlands Museum is a volunteer-run, non-profit institution dedicated to preserving and sharing the history of New Jersey's Meadowlands region. Permanent and rotating exhibits, a local history archive, a History Speaker Series, and a gift shop make it a rewarding stop for anyone curious about the stories behind the landscape.

blocks.title: Butterfish Sushi
blocks.html: A standout on Franklin Place in downtown Rutherford, Butterfish Sushi has built its following on freshly flown-in fish and a menu that takes quality seriously. Whether you're dining in or ordering for takeout, the commitment to freshness and precision makes every visit worth planning around.

blocks.title: Sonoma Bistro
blocks.html: Tucked into the heart of Rutherford's midtown on Park Avenue, Sonoma Bistro serves New American cuisine in a warm, casual bistro setting. The menu spans creative breakfasts, indulgent pasta dishes, and chef specialties like short rib risotto and spicy Cajun penne, and the BYOB policy makes a great meal feel even more like a treat.

items.q: How old do you have to be for cannabis delivery in Rutherford?
items.a_html: New Jersey's adult-use cannabis law sets the minimum age at 21. We’ll verify your age when you create your Lady L account, and your driver will confirm your ID again at the door before the handoff is completed. No exceptions apply.

items.q: What ID do you accept for delivery?
items.a_html: Any valid, government-issued photo ID qualifies. Driver's licenses, state-issued IDs, and passports are all accepted. Out-of-state IDs are welcome. Your ID must be uploaded to your Lady L account before placing your first order, and the physical ID must be present when your driver arrives.

items.q: Is a medical card required for Rutherford weed delivery?
items.a_html: Nope, no medical card needed. Lady L is an adult-use dispensary open to any customer 21 or older. A confirmed Lady L account and a valid ID are the only requirements to get started.

items.q: What’s the purchase limit for a cannabis delivery order?
items.a_html:
New Jersey law allows us to sell up to the equivalent of 28.35 grams, or one ounce, of usable cannabis per transaction. That total can include any combination of the following:

  • Dried Flower/Bud: 28.35 grams (1 ounce).
  • Concentrates/Resin/Oils: 4 grams (solid or liquid/vaporized oil).
  • Ingestible Items (Gummies/Edibles): 1,000 mg of THC (roughly ten 100mg packages).
  • Maximum Possession Limit: Up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products.
  • Mixing Products: You can mix and match, for example, by purchasing 1/2 ounce of flower and 2 grams of concentrates.
  • Daily Limits: The 1-ounce limit is generally considered a daily limit across all dispensaries.

items.q: What are the taxes on cannabis delivery orders in New Jersey?
items.a_html: New Jersey adult-use cannabis purchases include a 6.625% state sales tax, a 2% municipal transfer or user tax, where applicable, and a $2.50-per-ounce Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF). These apply equally to delivery orders, and every applicable charge is itemized at checkout before you confirm.
